title: eGFRcrea predicted effector genes (Liu et al., 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Epigenomic and transcriptomic analyses define core cell types, genes and targetable mechanisms for kidney disease.
Liu H, et al.
Nat Genet. 2022 Jul;54(7):950-962. doi: 10.1038/s41588-022-01097-w.
PMID: 35710981

The list below integrates results from 8 methods to prioritize putative kidney function effector genes at loci genetically associated with eGFRcrea:

  • meQTLs + eQTM
  • eQTLs
  • Colocalization
  • Multiple-trait colocalization
  • Mendelian randomization
  • Heterogeneity in dependent instruments (HEIDI)
  • Enhancer-gene links
  • Single cell co-accessibility

Priority scores represent the number of evidence types supporting each prediction, and range from 8 to 1.

Access a complementary view of these results in an interface created by the Susztak lab.

Read a commentary on this effector gene prioritization study (Devuyst and Kiryluk, 2023).
